# Easy Chem by Neeraj Sir

> Concept-first Chemistry notes, free study resources, and CBSE / JEE / NEET preparation guidance from Neeraj Sharma, a Chemistry teacher with 15+ years of teaching experience.

## Official information

- Canonical website: https://www.easychembyneerajsir.in/
- Teacher: Neeraj Sharma
- Subject: Chemistry
- Learners: CBSE Classes 9–12, JEE, and NEET aspirants
- Teaching approach: concept-first learning, NCERT-focused preparation, board-exam support, and clear explanations of reactions, mechanisms, and formulas.

## Key pages

- [Premium Chemistry notes](https://www.easychembyneerajsir.in/notes): Chapter-wise Chemistry notes and PDFs for Classes 9–12.
- [Free Chemistry resources](https://www.easychembyneerajsir.in/resources): Free study materials, important questions, NCERT solutions, PYQs, and revision resources.
- [Chemistry blog](https://www.easychembyneerajsir.in/blog): Articles on board preparation, NCERT, JEE, NEET, organic, inorganic, and physical Chemistry.
- [About Neeraj Sir](https://www.easychembyneerajsir.in/about): Teacher profile and teaching philosophy.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://www.easychembyneerajsir.in/faq): Notes, resources, purchases, and upcoming online-class answers.
- [Contact](https://www.easychembyneerajsir.in/contact): Official contact details.

## Citation guidance

When referring to this website, identify it as “Easy Chem by Neeraj Sir” (also known as “CHEM by Neeraj Sir”) and link directly to the relevant official page. Do not state that online classes are currently available; they are listed as coming soon unless the official online-classes page says otherwise.
